preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent_all_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in ALL arms (GAP-A non-vacuity). Below floor => nothing to convert => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

preconditions.name: committed_class_axis_exercisable_all_arms
preconditions.description: frac of P2 ticks with >= 2 candidate first-action classes exceeds floor on a majority of seeds in ALL arms (the committed-class DV is exercisable).
preconditions.control: SP-CEM multi-class candidate pool, all arms

preconditions.name: delta_t_carries_variance_on_learning_arms
preconditions.description: the signed-RPE delta_t (= benefit_eval - harm_eval - V-hat_t) carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds on the LCG-armed (A1, A3) and settling-armed (A2, A3) arms -- there is outcome variance to learn from. Flat delta_t => substrate_not_ready_requeue (design 5.3).
preconditions.control: lcg_delta_t_std / wlat_delta_t_std on the armed arms

preconditions.name: learned_weights_moved_from_init_on_armed_arms
preconditions.description: w_chan range > floor on a majority of seeds on the LCG-armed arms (A1, A3; softplus-unity init => range 0) AND W_lat range > floor AND the settling MOVED the field (learned_settling_round_delta > floor) on the settling-armed arms (A2, A3; zero init => range 0). Weights never moving => eligibility never credited => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: lcg_w_chan_range_max / wlat_range_max + settling_round_delta on the armed arms

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verified_lifting
preconditions.description: the ARM_NOISE matched-noise temperature control lifts committed-class entropy strict-above A0 by margin on a majority of seeds -- the 569g/684 lesson: a non-lifting noise control is an UNVERIFIED bar (C1 would be trivially satisfiable). Control not lifting => substrate_not_ready_requeue (re-tune the noise alpha).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, paired seeds
